LNbits says coordinated attacks on 8 November compromised multiple installations, stole funds and disrupted services.

Versions before 1.7.0 are affected. The project points operators to 1.7.1 and says an update alone may not remove an existing server compromise or revoke exposed credentials.

The recovery plan covers a fresh server where compromise is suspected, wallet-key and funding-source credential rotation, and recreated extension connections.
